name: @ask-llm/grok-mcp

tools.name: ask-grok
tools.description: Send a prompt to Grok through either the supported xAI Responses API or Grok Build's headless CLI (default harness: xai-api; default API model: grok-4.7; CLI default: grok-4.7; reasoning effort: high). Requires XAI_API_KEY and can incur xAI API charges. Ask LLM never enables billing, priority processing, credits, overage, model substitution, or fallback. Returns the actual provider/model and usage through the standard structured AskResponse.

prompt.description: The question, code review request, or analysis task to send to Grok through the selected harness

model.description: Exact model ID understood by the selected harness. Do not set unless the user explicitly requests one. Defaults to smallprint-placeholder on xai-api or grok-4.7 on grok-cli; Ask LLM never rewrites or falls back from the requested model.

harness.description: Execution harness, kept separate from the Grok model selection: xai-api or grok-cli. Defaults to xai-api; no harness fallback is attempted.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth: low, medium, high, xhigh. Defaults to high; this is a request parameter, not a model-name suffix.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Verify Grok MCP configuration and list exact model IDs available to the configured xAI API key. Model discovery does not make a billed inference call.

message.description: A message to echo back without contacting a provider

harness.description: Harness whose exact model catalog should be listed

tools.name: get-usage-stats
tools.description: Get the current MCP server's session usage stats: total LLM calls, token totals (input/output/thinking/cached), wall time, and breakdowns per provider and per model. No data leaves your machine — counts are tracked in-memory for the lifetime of the server process. Returns both human-readable markdown and a structured JSON snapshot via outputSchema.
